meta_policy_notes: The meta-policy should select skills based on the provided activation rules, which are designed to be mutually exclusive and cover the relevant state space. 'stand_up' takes precedence for critical recovery. 'maintain_balance' is for idle or stationary states. 'accelerate' is for building speed, and 'run_fast' for sustaining high speeds. The reward terms within each skill guide the agent towards the desired behavior for that specific context.

skills.name: stand_up
skills.description: Recovers from a fallen or very low-pitch state, aiming for an upright posture.

reward_terms.description: Reward increasing torso pitch towards upright (0.0 rad)
Penalize high joint speeds during recovery

skills.name: maintain_balance
skills.description: Keeps the cheetah stable and upright when it's not actively trying to run fast or recover from a fall. This is a fallback skill, aiming for low energy consumption.

reward_terms.description: Penalize high joint speeds for stability and low energy
Reward maintaining torso pitch near upright (0.0 rad)

skills.name: accelerate
skills.description: Focuses on quickly increasing forward velocity from a low to medium speed.

reward_terms.description: Slightly penalize positive torso pitch to prevent falling forward

skills.name: run_fast
skills.description: Focuses on maintaining and maximizing high forward velocity.

reward_terms.description: Penalize excessive positive torso pitch (leaning too far forward)
Penalize high joint speeds for efficiency and stability
